t: Force-Multiplying Ikigai In The Age of AI
s: The article explores how AI is reshaping the web, focusing on the development of 'Pipulate,' a tool to help websites communicate with LLMs. It emphasizes the evolution of web standards and productivity principles, suggesting a puzzle-piece approach to integrating new tech like MCP with existing infrastructure.
sub: Pipulate: Website listener & LLM whisperer development
Evolution of web protocols (HTTP, MCP, NLWeb) and AI integration
Productivity principles (Ikigai, Kaizen, Pomodoro, Wabi-Sabi, Shoshin) applied to tech development
Network effects, open standards (TCP/IP, HTML, JavaScript), and incumbent technologies
